turns.text: You can almost feel the hand of Aasimti holding this place hidden in light and shadow. You feel rain on your face, the water soaking into the ground, and for a moment you sense the presence of Ch'ik'a as you almost feel the squashing of mud on your bare feet, through your armored boots.

turns.speaker: DM

As you feel Kenzo, Wellby and Seeker pulled away from you, you hear Wellby's voice in your mind just for a moment: "Find your way to the Feywild, to the portal near Eudomes' Tower; we will meet again there." And then you are hurtling towards the ground.

The sun low in the sky casts a beautiful golden light across the forest and mountains. In the distance in the valleys, you see a hint of shadows, dark spots, with no obvious clouds drifting over the ground. In the next moment you find yourself on the ground in the pine forests about halfway up the mountains, watching the light of a flickering campfire in the evening a few hundred feet ahead of you.
